items.title: Wall Street already loves ChatGPT. Now OpenAI is doubling down.
items.summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT for Financial Services on Thursday, bringing more data under the hood of the AI tool and adding new accuracy checks.

items.title: OpenAI courts Wall Street with ChatGPT for financial services, developed with Morgan Stanley
items.summary: The product will compete with a similar offering from Anthropic, but OpenAI says it's version is 'the one product' big banks will ever need.
items.titleZh: OpenAI通过与摩根士丹利共同开发的ChatGPT为金融服务赢得华尔街的青睐
items.summaryZh: 该产品将与Anthropic的类似产品竞争，但OpenAI表示，它的版本是大银行永远需要的“唯一产品”。

items.title: OpenAI targets work of Wall Street junior bankers with new ChatGPT for Financial Services
items.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services, targeting the labor-intensive research, modeling, and pitchbook tasks traditionally handled by junior bankers.
items.titleZh: OpenAI通过新的金融服务ChatGPT瞄准华尔街初级银行家的工作
items.summaryZh: OpenAI为金融服务推出了ChatGPT，针对传统上由初级银行家处理的劳动密集型研究、建模和宣传书任务。

items.title: This Guy Cloned Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Zuckerberg Into AI Bots. They Immediately Started Fighting
items.summary: Kun Chen built chatbot versions of four AI CEOs on SpaceXAI's new Grok Bot templates, locked them in one chat, and told them to debate the AI race until they agreed on something.
items.titleZh: 这个家伙把萨姆·奥特曼、埃隆·马斯克和扎克伯格克隆成了人工智能机器人。他们立即开始战斗
items.summaryZh: Kun Chen在SpaceXAI的新Grok Bot模板上构建了四位人工智能首席执行官的聊天机器人版本，将他们锁定在一个聊天中，并告诉他们辩论人工智能竞赛，直到他们达成一致。

items.title: SpaceX sues to block release of tax-break records for its Texas Terafab project
items.summary: Americans cite a lack of transparency as one of their biggest concerns around large AI infrastructure projects.

items.summaryZh: 美国人认为，缺乏透明度是他们对大型人工智能基础设施项目最大的担忧之一。

items.title: We asked AI how it could kill humanity. Here's what it told us.
items.summary: We asked four of the most-used generative AI tools what an AI doomsday could look like.
items.titleZh: 我们问AI如何杀死人类。这是它告诉我们的。
items.summaryZh: 我们询问了四种最常用的生成式人工智能工具，人工智能世界末日会是什么样子。

items.title: Congressman presses DOT on Tesla FSD after 43 sleeping-driver videos
items.summary:
A US congressman is demanding the Department of Transportation explain what it’s doing about Tesla’s Autopilot and Full Self-Driving after an NBC News investigation surfaced dozens of videos of drivers apparently asleep at the wheel.



Rep. Raja Krishnamoort…
items.titleZh: 国会议员在43段驾驶员睡眠视频后向DOT施压
items.summaryZh: 美国全国广播公司新闻的一项调查显示，数十段司机显然在开车时睡着的视频曝光后，一名美国国会议员要求交通部解释其对特斯拉自动驾驶仪和全自动驾驶的做法。

items.title: Humans need to 'surf the wave' of AI rather than get swallowed by it, Chesky says at Communacopia
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi, and SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen are set to speak at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference.
items.titleZh: 切斯基在Communacopia表示，人类需要“冲浪”人工智能，而不是被它吞噬
items.summaryZh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋、优步首席执行官Dara Khosrowshahi和SpaceX首席财务官Bret Johnsen将在高盛Communacopia+技术会议上发言。

items.title: Trump’s $5,000 ‘dividend’ is really a $1.15 trillion hole in the deficit, top economist estimates
items.summary: Penn Wharton's Kent Smetters says the payout, floated at the GOP's midterm convention, could add up to $1.35 trillion to the $40 trillion national debt.
items.titleZh: 顶级经济学家估计，特朗普的5000美元“股息”实际上是赤字中的1.15万亿美元
items.summaryZh: 宾夕法尼亚沃顿商学院的Kent Smetters表示，在共和党中期大会上提出的支出可能会在40万亿美元的国债中增加1.35万亿美元。

items.title: The Boring Company raises $3B in round led by UAE

items.title: Elon Musk threatens to sue over Gibney documentary's "space lasers" claim
items.summary: The tech billionaire's attorney has put documentarian Alex Gibney and his production company on legal notice, claiming the Oscar-winning director defamed Musk in his nearly four-hour documentary.
items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克威胁要就吉布尼纪录片的“太空激光器”索赔提起诉讼
items.summaryZh: 这位科技亿万富翁的律师已向纪录片制作人亚历克斯·吉布尼及其制作公司发出法律通知，声称这位奥斯卡获奖导演在其近四小时的纪录片中诽谤了马斯克。
